name: EPIC 212352199
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 10.2 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212352199 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.248353 (16th-84th percentiles 9.964466-10.660871), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212352199 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3550.234375 (16th-84th percentiles 3474.375-3648.828125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.30 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,550 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.89 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,552 K at its surface.
